issue: Absolute duplicate records across 23 business columns (excluding row_id)
detection_rule: raw_df.duplicated(subset=[col for col in raw_df.columns if col != "row_id"])

issue: Duplicate booking_id values or discrepancies due to uppercase/lowercase and whitespace differences
Misplaced date values (in YYYY-MM-DD format) erroneously recorded inside the reservation_status column
Presence of missing tokens (NULL, NA, ?, -, N/A), empty strings, or full country names instead of ISO codes
Presence of currency symbols (€, EUR), decimal commas, or missing tokens within the ADR column
detection_rule: adr contains non-numeric chars, currency symbols, or missing tokens

issue: Unstandardized arrival date formats mixed across multiple distinct structures (e.g., DD/MM/YYYY, English full text)
detection_rule: arrival_date has multiple unstandardized date formats or empty

issue: Presence of irregular labels such as "Undefined", empty values, or redundant whitespaces
Presence of missing tokens, empty strings, or "Undefined" labels (which structurally equate to SC)
Presence of empty cells or text-based missing tokens instead of numeric integer values
Empty values, missing tokens, or malformed formats within the reservation status update date column
